description: Prior notification for the demolition of front vacant office building.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The hereby approved demolition must be completed within 5 years beginning from the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed demolition shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the documents submitted (Demolition checklist, Ferrari Demolition statement, Site plan showing buildings to be demolished received: 12th April 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
